name: Baghvan Pench (Taj Safaris)
location: Awarghani Village, near Khursapar gate (MP side, shared border)
why_special: Taj Safaris flagship — 12 suites with private plunge pools, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris, full-board Indian and continental. The luxury Pench safari signature; bookable as Pench Maharashtra-side base since most Pench tigers cross the inter-state border.

name: Pench Jungle Camp
why_special: 30-cottage safari resort by Sillari gate (Pench Maharashtra) — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris. The senior mid-range Pench-Maharashtra base; runs since 2007 with consistent Tripadvisor reviews.

name: MTDC Pench Resort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's value-rate Pench resort near Sillari gate — simple A/C cottages, safari-booking desk, the budget alternative to Pench Jungle Camp for self-driving Nagpur visitors.
